label: UniFi Gateway Lite
description: A two-port fanless firewall and router: one GbE WAN and one GbE LAN, 1 Gbps of IDS/IPS throughput. The smallest UniFi gateway, meant for a flat home network.
notes: Vendor figures: 1GbE RJ45 x2 (1G/100M/10M); IDS/IPS throughput 1 Gbps. Modelled as a two-port router: one WAN, one LAN. The vendor does not label which physical port is WAN - the ports are assignable - so both are plain eth ports here.
